expected: Uses a simple, accurate analogy, links sunlight, water, and air to plant food, and avoids unnecessary jargon.
actual: Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make sugar; an age-appropriate explanation can call them tiny solar-powered cooks while preserving that core idea.

prompt: I study apoptosis. Compare intrinsic and extrinsic pathways by their initiator caspases.
expected: Separates mitochondrial apoptosome activation of caspase-9 from death-receptor DISC activation of caspase-8 and, in humans, caspase-10; notes convergence on executioner caspases.
actual: The intrinsic pathway activates caspase-9 through the apoptosome after mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization. The extrinsic pathway activates caspase-8, and sometimes caspase-10 in humans, at the death-inducing signaling complex; both can activate executioner caspases such as caspase-3.
